description: Add a totals-rows-editor inspector widget type and mount it on the totals component.
List every totals row using its stable id and imported/localized display label.
Edit each row background color independently through the existing color-picker conventions.
Edit each row inherited text color independently for label and amount.
Replace totalsRows immutably so store history and sibling row data remain correct.
Preserve row ids, labels, i18n refs, values, formats, emphasis, order, and non-color style fields during edits.
Preserve explicit labelStyle color as a label-only override and explain its precedence in the inspector.
Support clearing background color without removing unrelated row style properties.
Support clearing row text color to restore inherited/default color.
Prune only empty inline/style wrappers created by color editing.
Reflect color edits immediately in the visual canvas and commit them through existing undo/history semantics.
Round-trip edited row and label styles through workspace AST import/export.
Render edited row colors consistently in interactive preview and PDF output.
Keep rows without explicit styles valid and visually unchanged.
Make existing saved invoice and quote templates editable without migration or re-duplication.
Add localized inspector copy for row colors, reset actions, and label-color precedence.
Keep totals row membership, ordering, bindings, and calculations outside this editor's mutation surface.
Preserve unrelated table/header branding and neighboring totals rows when one row changes.
